author: Joltz_
body:
This is just an idea I had, basically its where each team has their own grand total of points, and the team with the most points at the end of the year gets a very special prize or something.

So basically the concept works as if we had many small events during the year for team points, and then you had the Major events (Tournaments) for lots of points. So you could get points for sportsmanship, participation, skill and progress.
